title: Short Drama Apps Dataset
description:
Store ratings, install counts, in-app prices, aggregated user-review complaint shares and data-based scores for the short drama (vertical micro-drama) apps ranked by Vertical Drama Reviews. Updated weekly, with a monthly snapshot archive. One row per app: 25 apps in this version, 24 fields.

What is in it. For every short drama (vertical micro-drama) app in the Vertical Drama Reviews ranking: App Store and Google Play ratings and rating counts, the Google Play install range, in-app prices, the share of analyzed user reviews that mention billing, ads, paywall and bug problems or praise the shows, and the data-based score and rank shown on the site. Files: data/short-drama-apps.csv, data/short-drama-apps.json (same values plus field definitions) and monthly snapshots in data/history/.

Sources. Store data comes from the US App Store and US Google Play listings. Review columns come from a sample of up to 150 App Store and 150 Google Play reviews per app, spread over the past 12 months; each review is labeled by theme automatically by a language model. Only the resulting shares (0–1) are published, never the reviews themselves or quotes from them.

Limitations. Apple shows only the most popular in-app purchases on an app's page, not the full price list, so iap_price_min_usd and iap_price_max_usd describe that top list only, and subscription_seen_in_app_store_top_iaps is either true or empty (unknown), never false. Install counts are the lower bound of the range Google Play shows. Empty cells mean the value is not available.

Updates. Data is refreshed weekly; a monthly snapshot is added on the first update of each month, and each monthly snapshot is released here as a new version.

Field dictionary and downloads: https://verticaldramareviews.com/data. Methodology and score formula: https://verticaldramareviews.com/how-we-test.
